The '''LE-34 Miniprobe''' was a type of small [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The LE-34 Miniprobe appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet that could be acquired from the Gatekeeper's Stronghold Pack.
